question: Approve the protocol design with D1 to D7 as recommended (D1 the project counts and sends crossings, the heartbeat carries the value; D2 retire relay.capacity.ceiling and express relay's ceiling as ops.metric.*; D3 recovered marks the ops task closable without a model run and never closes the Draft PR; D4 reach the Captain means a Slack mention of his Slack user; D5 separate prod and preview/dev signing secrets; D6 store recommendation recorded, not built: per-event create-only Blobs keys on Netlify, JSONL plus DuckDB on one process; D7 the project decides period membership at its exact boundary instant and period stays that instant's UTC date), the contract fixes found by probe P1 (free text refused, contract split into its own module) and a contract-only PR from origin/main landed first? Approving accepts all of these as written and enters implementation.

artifacts.summary: Protocol: the project counts and sends one signed crossing event per threshold plus recovered and heartbeat events; every field is enumerated or a no-space pattern; the inbox routes by environment and severity; senders reuse the id on retry. Probe P1 showed r1's contract v1 accepts a 500-character instruction and arbitrary ids, so the validator is fixed and split out before landing. qnow reviewed as first adopter: it cannot send crossings until its task adds a per-period counter (the Captain's call), and its SMS budget is not on record.
